Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Gate team-b.

Our sprint goal is: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, is story 4 done for the idempotency keys, is story 3 done, and is task 19 done, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12 which is still blocked? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests today.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Daniel, task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll finish it today.

Daniel, task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, has been Active for 2 days. Still on track?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Thanks, Daniel. Maya, is bug 12 pairing for staging access done, is story 2 settlement file validation done, and is story 5 chase done?
What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline; I'll add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for the blocker accessing the platform team’s staging gateway to get past bug 12, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with Daniel on the staging access today.

Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker that the PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review, and blockers will be flagged for follow-up, plus your commitment to chase them today.
Thanks, Maya. Admin, is story 1 done, and is task 14 done? What did you finish, what’s next, and is anything blocking you?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: Keep working on the payment retry story today.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the sandbox being down and your plan to finish task 14 tomorrow, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker: Waiting on the sandbox with the platform team, and it will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Quick recap: blockers raised were access to the platform team’s staging gateway, PCI scan exceptions waiting on security review, the sandbox being down, and waiting on the sandbox with the platform team. We also parked the side discussion between Daniel and Admin about gateway timeouts for offline follow-up. No one was absent and everyone responded, and there were no uncovered flagged items. Follow-ups, including anything for absences or non-responses if they occur, are coming in Teams. Thanks everyone.
